headline: New project additions improve upon pre-sales visibility

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : Max Estates reported revenue, EBITDA and PAT of ₹ 52.8, ₹ 5.2 and ₹ 1.1 crore in Q2FY27.
Commercial leasing remained steady, with lease rental income at ₹ 39 crore, while Max Asset Services revenue grew 28% YoY to ₹ 16.5 crore.

It has a 13.2 msf business development pipeline with an aspirational target of adding ~3msf of projects. • Pre - leasing of Under - construction annuity assets healthy : MEL has three operational assets totalling ~1.5 msf, operating at 100% occupancy and over 90% EBITDA margins (₹ 158 crore rental income in FY26).

Rating and Target Price : • We retain Buy on the stock with a revised SOTP based price target of ₹ 680 (factoring newly acquired projects and assigning nil premium to NAV).

The company expects collections of ₹ 2500-3000 crore during FY27E. • Business Development : Max Estate secured multiple business deals worth ₹12,500-15,000 crore. it secured a long term (5-7 ears) land parcel of 85 acre (4-6 msf) with estimated GDV of ₹ 10000-12000 crore in West Delhi and a 9.8 acre land in Ghaziabad with estimated GDV of ₹ 2500-3000 crore.
